summary: HCW Biologics filed a Form 8-K on September 9, 2026, reporting that it filed Amendment No. 1 to its Preliminary Proxy Statement originally filed September 8, 2026. The amendment withdraws Proposal No. 2, which sought stockholder approval of an amended performance-based equity plan for eligible officers, directors and employees, following stockholder feedback, and resets the special meeting and record dates. CEO Hing C. Wong signed the filing. No special-situation transaction is present; this is a routine proxy amendment and meeting logistics change, with governance optics around the withdrawn equity plan the only item to monitor.
